name: Rougi Maki
source:
Maki is one of the best students at the school, even though she usually skips class and stays in the forest. Bringing along her own tent, she does fieldwork in the forest near the town that’s supposedly closed off to the public. Cheeky and cool, but weak to being called ‘cute’.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/09/12/natsuyume-nagisa-review/]Micchi's review[/url]]
